title: Experiment 2: + context features
change: Added KnowBot's own rank, page votes (candidates from the same page, best similarity of the page, total keyword score of the page) and the document share.
finding: Hit@1 above the baseline (0.462 vs 0.438) and PR-AUC more than doubled, but MRR still slightly below (0.579 vs 0.585).
